name: Saffron & Vine
tagline: Mediterranean fine dining on a candlelit dusk terrace
description: A dusk-terrace dining experience where a candlelit 3D table scene tilts with the cursor and seven tasting courses plate themselves as you scroll.

name: Flour & Fold
tagline: French pâtisserie in butter cream, copper and morning light

name: Koya Ramen Bar
tagline: Late-night ramen from a lacquer-and-neon Tokyo alley
description: A neon-lit alley counter where canvas steam rises off a cursor-tilted ramen bowl and menu tiles flick like chopsticks under your pointer.
